facts.statement: The fuzz entry’s primary operation is md_html on the bytes remaining after two unsigned input words. Those words supply parser_flags and renderer_flags.
Inputs shorter than two unsigned words return before md_html is called. The build recipe compiles this entry and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the compiled fuzz entry and linked libraries.

facts.statement: The after source defines MD_FLAG_SPOILERS as 0x10000 and specifies ||hidden text|| as a spoiler span recognized only with that flag.
A finite input can put 0x10000 in the first unsigned word and ||text|| after the two flag words. md_html copies parser_flags into its parser, installs the HTML span callbacks, and calls md_parse.

evidence.dependency_reason: Gives the bit value selectable in the first input word.
Shows how md_html passes parser flags and installs the rendering callbacks.
Shows the call from md_html to md_parse.

facts.statement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, the parser marks pipe characters for scanning and collects each adjacent double pipe as one potential opener and closer mark.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows collection of double-pipe marks once pipes are scanned.

facts.statement: Outside table mode, inline analysis calls md_analyze_link_contents. With the spoiler flag set, that helper sends unresolved double-pipe marks to md_analyze_pipe, which pairs a potential closer with a pending opener and resolves their range.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the flag gate and call to the double-pipe resolver.
Shows pairing and resolution of opener and closer marks.

facts.statement: Inline processing dispatches resolved double-pipe marks as MD_SPAN_SPOILER enter and leave callbacks. The HTML callbacks emit <x-spoiler> and </x-spoiler> for those span events.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the opening HTML tag emitted for MD_SPAN_SPOILER.
Shows the closing HTML tag emitted for MD_SPAN_SPOILER.

facts.statement: The renderer suppresses nested HTML tags inside an image label. A witness for emitted spoiler tags therefore needs a context outside an image label.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the corresponding closing-tag suppression while image nesting remains positive.

facts.statement: In table mode, md_analyze_inlines handles single-pipe cell boundaries and returns before md_analyze_link_contents. This gate limits that context; the supplied non-table call path remains available.
The complete before span enum has no spoiler type. Its pipe collector creates single-pipe marks only under table mode or MD_FLAG_WIKILINKS, and its HTML span callbacks have no spoiler case.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the before collector’s pipe handling.
Shows the complete before opening span switch.
Shows the complete before closing span switch.

facts.statement: The complete old harness has no assertion or check of md_html’s return value or generated output. Its output callback returns without processing the text.
